name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and plant your feet flat.
Set your shoulder blades back and hold both dumbbells above your shoulders with palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows at a slight angle from your ribs to lower the dumbbells beside your chest.
Press both dumbbells smoothly back above your shoulders until your arms straighten.
tips: Keep each wrist stacked directly above its elbow throughout the press.
Maintain contact with the bench through your upper back and hips as you reverse the press.
